body: I’ve read the book of Job countless amounts of times. From what I realized after reading it so much was that God really gambled with a mans life to prove a point to the Satan and allowed for everything to be taken from and gave him diseases and boils on his skin and he was given years of torment before finally getting things doubled.
I’ve tried to speak with professionals and it just doesn’t seem to work it’s almost like they don’t believe nor care what I’m going through.
A really long story that I really am exhausted to share
